content.title: Open representative testimonial book links from the success stories page
content.intent: Prove the success stories page exposes working testimonial book links that lead from the social-proof page into showcased book detail pages on the platform.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to repeated testimonial links and used a covering array over testimonial_position classes {first, middle, last}. Risk-judged interaction strength was 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss applies; covering_array degraded to strength=1 because there was only one input, so the scenario sweeps first, middle, and last testimonials as representative link positions. Negative, boundary, security, a11y, perf, and i18n scenario families were judged not applicable from the current source because REQ-09 specifies only public content presence and link availability, with no alternate outcomes, role gates, limits, or localized variants.
